resources.string: Bring recent runs, walks, rides, distance, calories, routes, and heart rate into Plainstride. Completed Plainstride activities can also be shared with Health Connect.

Allow the data types you want Plainstride to use.
You choose each permission. Plainstride only reads or writes the data types you allow, and you can revoke access at any time.
Health Connect access was removed. Reconnect to resume importing and sharing activities.
